records.title: Development and Maintenance of National Highways
details: d: Five ATMS projects on pilot basis have been taken up by the Government on key high density highway corridors.

records.title: Sanctioned Railway Underpasses and Overbridges in Akola and Washim Districts
details: a to e: Presently, 06 Nos. ROBs and 05 Nos. RUBs are sanctioned in the Akola district and one RUB is sanctioned in Washim district. Additionally, the work of preparation of technical feasibility Report/Detailed Project Report (TFR/DPR) for the construction of ROBs/RUBs in lieu of 03 Nos. LCs have been taken up.
